additionalRules: An Arathorn's Stand Army must always contain Arathorn, who is always the Army's General.

specialRules.name: "They're dangerous folk, wandering the wilds"
specialRules.text: Friendly Rangers of the North increase their Attacks value to 2.

specialRules.name: Silent Ambush
specialRules.text: In Scenarios where you roll for Warbands to arrive, or to see which part of the board a Warband deploys in (not deployment zone rolls), this Army may modify the roll by +1 or -1.

specialRules.name: Heir of Isildur
specialRules.text: Whenever Arathorn spends a Might Point, roll a D6. On a 4+ the point is free and does not reduce his store of Might.

specialRules.name: Chieftain of the Dunedain
specialRules.text: Friendly Dunedain Hero models may benefit from Arathorn's Stand Fast.

specialRules.name: Banner of Arwen Evenstar
specialRules.text: A banner with 6" range rather than 3"; Halbarad suffers no Duel Roll penalty for carrying it. Friendly models within 6" and Line of Sight automatically pass Courage tests.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader. They may, however, be included in another Hero model's warband as one of their followers.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from prancingponypub army-list page. Full stat blocks, wargear, and special-rule text from the matching Arnor & Angmar faction page (stat blocks are hosted per-faction, not per army-list, on this site).
